'''Moss Fotballklubb''' is a [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, founded on 28 August 1906. They play in the [[1. divisjon]], the second highest division in the [[Norwegian football league system]]. They played in the [[Eliteserien|Norwegian top flight]] between 1937–1939, 1953–54, 1977–1985 (9 seasons), 1987–1990 (4 seasons), 1996 and 1998–2002. The club came close to earning promotion to the top flight in [[2024 Eliteserien#Relegation play-offs|2024]], but lost the play-off against Haugesund."}}
